one_liner: NotebookLM has an official Google Cloud API only for Enterprise (licensed, 15-license minimum) plus a preview personal-account API with OAuth; consumer access otherwise relies on unofficial cookie-based libraries and community MCPs.
access_notes: Official Enterprise API requires Gemini Notebook Enterprise licenses in a Google Cloud project ($9/license/month, 15 minimum, trial available). A free Public Preview API exists for personal Google accounts only (Workspace unsupported, no SLA), and it only creates notebooks and adds sources. Unofficial consumer routes use browser cookies.
blocker_notes: Enterprise API needs paid licenses and admin setup. The free preview is narrow (notebooks and sources only), covers personal accounts only, and OAuth tokens expire in about 1 hour. Unofficial cookie-based clients are brittle and risk breaking Google's terms.

evidence.quote: A personal Google account (Workspace accounts are not supported yet), a Google Cloud project and an OAuth 2.0 user token; the API takes no API keys.
NotebookLM does not offer this project a public OAuth or service-account API. The Web backend therefore uses Google browser-session cookies.
